kind_of_thing.quote: Anteaters are the four extant mammal species in the suborder Vermilingua (meaning 'worm tongue'), commonly known for eating ants and termites.

kind_of_animal.quote: An anteater is a mammal of the family Myrmecophagidae and the suborder Vermilingua.
